_about: AetherStore list. Aether reads https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crszy/aether/main/store/index.json (falls back to the copy it ships with). Each entry is installed straight from its own repo; 'parts' (optional) tells the store where things are when the repo doesn't use the usual .config layout. Types: hypr, caelestia, noctalia, ryoku, dms, end4, quickshell, kitty, foot, alacritty, wezterm, fastfetch (into = sub-folder), starship, cava, waybar, fish, wallpapers, chrome, wt, wtscheme, aether, hyprlock (a folder with hyprlock.conf; style packs are found by themselves, one part per style). chrome parts may add app (firefox | zen: only that browser), only (list of files/folders under path), into (a sub-folder of chrome/ that userChrome.css / userContent.css @import) and userjs (a user.js whose prefs are added). Category shell = a whole Quickshell config: installed with install-config.ps1 into ~/.config/quickshell/<config>, no parts. preview: an image path relative to this file (store/previews/<id>.jpg), or a full https link.
